message:
You know that one friend who just can't handle a blackout? 🕯️ Well, I like to think of myself as the calm voice in the storm. When the lights go out, it’s good to have a plan in place, and I found this super helpful resource that walks you through what to do during those unexpected power outages. From keeping your food fresh to staying safe and comfortable, it’s all about staying calm and collected. 

So, why not take a moment to check it out? You never know when it might come in handy! What’s your go-to tip for handling a blackout?
